tool_input.body:
## Summary

Ten issues were filed in `punt-labs/ethos` covering eleven findings. This closes the xboing beads that carried them and rescopes the two that were half tool-bug, half ours. No code changes.

## Closed — fully upstream

| Bead | Went to |
|---|---|
| `xboing-pf7d` | `ethos-5f0k`, `iraa`, `qu9z` (×2), `vqwn`, `m1ak`, `lldo`, plus `qtiv` and `015a` for the two unnumbered observations |
| `xboing-dlg` | `ethos-9yfp` — this bead always said so: *"Seed lives in the ethos repo (separate PR territory)"* |
| `xboing-yeuw` | Part 3 fixed by `ethos enable`; part 2 is `ethos-vqwn` (P1) |

`xboing-yeuw`'s title — *"no commit-msg hook exists"* — is now **false**; the hook exists. Closing beats leaving a bead that misleads the next reader.

## Rescoped

**`xboing-icp1`** is now xboing-only. Its gitignore WARN was resolved by `ethos enable`, and doctor's PASS-for-an-absent-hook moved to `ethos-bfml`. What remains is genuinely ours — retitled to match.

## New

**`xboing-ven1`**, split out of `yeuw`. `docs/GIT.md` declares a commit without a `Mission:` trailer *"a defect, not a style choice."* No commit on master has ever carried one, so the rule marks the entire history defective and gets read as noise. It stays wrong after `ethos-vqwn` lands: every pre-hook commit lacks a trailer, and genuinely non-mission commits always will.

## The line this draws

Ethos owns its code. xboing owns its configuration and documentation. Three items are ours because three **xboing-tracked files** disagree with each other or with reality:

| Contradiction | Bead |
|---|---|
| `.claude/rules/delegation.md` says jck is read-only; `.punt-labs/ethos/roles/vision-keeper.yaml` grants `Read/Write/Edit/Grep/Glob/WebFetch` | `xboing-c-xzt` |
| `.claude/agents/latex-tech-architect.md` tracked, but absent from `.punt-labs/ethos/teams/xboing.yaml` | `xboing-icp1` |
| `docs/GIT.md`'s missing-trailer rule | `xboing-ven1` |

None needs an ethos change. Ethos renders faithfully what this repo tells it.

## Test plan

- [ ] CI green (bead JSONL and audit artifacts only)

`ethos doctor` exits 1 in this repo because of one inconsistency in xboing's own configuration:

  Orphaned agent files  FAIL  orphaned agent files (not on any team): latex-tech-architect

Two xboing-tracked files disagree:

  .claude/agents/latex-tech-architect.md      TRACKED here
  .punt-labs/ethos/teams/xboing.yaml          does NOT list it

Both are ours. Ethos is correctly reporting a real inconsistency in this repo's configuration — the FAIL is earned, not a tool bug.

CONSEQUENCE: CLAUDE.md's Session Start step 4 says `ethos doctor` "must report all PASS". It does not, and has not for some time, so that step is unsatisfiable as written and gets skipped.

THE FIX IS PROBABLY TO ADD IT TO THE TEAM, NOT DELETE THE FILE. The agent is real and works — it appears in the session's available agent types as "Produces technical documentation in LaTeX — architecture docs, design reviews, specifications, API documentation, system overviews". Removing a functioning agent to silence a red line would lose a capability in order to make a health check green, which is the wrong trade.

OPEN QUESTION, needs a human decision rather than a guess: is latex-tech-architect actually wanted on the xboing team? It has never been used in a mission in this repo. If the answer is no, deleting the agent file is a legitimate resolution — but that is a decision about what capabilities this project wants, not about doctor's exit code.
